title: Rethinking the Flow-Based Gradual Domain Adaptation: A Semi-Dual Optimal Transport Perspective
tldr_zh: 用熵正则半对偶 UOT 替代目标 PDF 估计，逐步生成 GDA 中间域，三个 GDA 数据集与 Office-Home 上精度最高
tldr_en: Entropy-regularized semi-dual UOT replaces target PDF estimation for flow-based GDA intermediate domain generation, achieving best accuracy on GDA and Office-Home benchmarks
